Encord is our solution of choice. If we will buy something, we will buy
Encord. The current issue is we are working on our internal strategy as we
will need this for many, many projects.

For now, we’d like to propose starting with a single project. This would
involve chest X-ray (CXR) classification for 2,000 images, with access for
three accounts (1 admin and 2 labellers). Our budget for this project is
$3,000.

This project will be free for low- and middle-income countries and is
expected to create a meaningful social impact. Let me know if this approach
works for you.

Looking forward to your thoughts.

Best regards,
Reeda
